purpose: Machine-readable governance layer for canon status, scope, promotion, holding, and projection boundaries.

authority.rule: Only an explicit creator declaration may promote material to locked canon.

statuses.LOCKED: Explicit creator canon declaration is attached with provenance and scope.
statuses.SUPPORTED: Consistent with canon but interpretive or incomplete; not independently locked.
statuses.BRANCH_ONLY: Valid only inside its named branch and does not propagate upward or sideways.
statuses.HOLDING: Identity, scope, contradiction, or provenance is unresolved.
statuses.DERIVED: Generated from source material but has no independent canon authority.
statuses.DEPRECATED: Intentionally retired and preserved for provenance.
statuses.CONTRADICTION: Conflicts with an equal or higher authority source and requires resolution.
statuses.LOCK_CLAIM_PENDING_SOURCE: A secondary record claims a lock but the originating creator declaration has not yet been attached.

projection_rule.principle: Representations may express, test, or provide evidence for canon; they do not create canon.

system_roles.canon_registry: Machine-readable canonical state, provenance, corrections, stable IDs, scope, and branch assignment.
system_roles.naming_crosswalk: Aliases, prior names, variants, collisions, and identity-resolution proposals.
system_roles.knotwork_nexus: Relationships, routing, dependencies, and source links.
system_roles.guidebook: Readable governance, weekly reviews, and Cross-Branch Holding Area.
system_roles.living_atlas_world_bible: Readable world references compiled from approved records.
system_roles.visual_archive: Visual evidence, approved masters, variants, and correction notes.
system_roles.causal_state_engine: Derives consequences and dependencies from canonical state; cannot promote claims.
system_roles.research: Evidence and hypotheses; cannot create in-world truth.
system_roles.scenario_runtime: Testing and instantiated experience; repetition cannot promote canon.

branch_boundaries.TRIQUEL: Galaxy-scale scope; individual worlds, regions, and branch-local facts do not propagate upward or sideways without creator approval.
branch_boundaries.HELLS_BRANCH: Experimental/alternate branch; mechanics, characters, architecture, and events remain branch-local unless explicitly promoted.
branch_boundaries.CROSS_BRANCH_HOLDING: Uncertain overlaps, mirrored concepts, shared names, variants, and unclear source assignments wait here.
